title: Best Facial Skincare (2026)
summary: Four face moisturizers recommended by multiple sources for different skin types, ranging from dry to oily and sensitive.
method: Picks were selected based on recommendations from Consumer Reports, NBC News, The Good Trade, and Allure. Products recommended by more than one source were prioritized.
assumptions: Prices listed are from Allure and may vary by retailer. No prices were provided by other sources.

products.name: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Double Repair Face Moisturizer
why: Allure names this the Best Overall face moisturizer. It is designed to keep skin looking healthy and radiant.
Consumer Reports tested 19 moisturizers, including La Roche-Posay, to find the best options for dry, oily, normal, and combination skin. The brand is listed among the top tested brands.
products.desc: A face moisturizer from La Roche-Posay. It is a cream formula intended to plump, soften, and comfort skin. It helps seal in other skincare ingredients.
products.benefit: Picture a person with normal to combination skin applying this cream in the morning. It provides hydration without feeling heavy. It is the only pick in this guide named 'Best Overall' by a major beauty publication. The catch: It may not provide enough moisture for very dry or mature skin compared to richer creams.
cons: May not be rich enough for very dry skin
Price is higher than some drugstore options
products.best_for: People with normal to combination skin looking for a reliable daily moisturizer.
products.skip_if: You have very dry or mature skin that requires a heavier, more occlusive cream.

products.name: Aestura Atobarrier 365 Cream
why: Allure identifies this as the Best for Dry Skin. It is a cream designed to provide deep hydration.
Consumer Reports tested moisturizers for dry skin, and this product is a top contender in that category according to Allure's testing.
products.desc: A face moisturizer from Aestura. It is a cream formula specifically targeted at dry skin. It helps restore the moisture barrier.
products.benefit: Picture someone with flaky, tight skin using this cream at night. It provides intense hydration to comfort dry areas. It is the only pick in this guide specifically labeled for dry skin by Allure. The catch: It may be too heavy for people with oily or acne-prone skin.
pros: Named Best for Dry Skin by Allure
cons: May be too heavy for oily skin
products.best_for: People with dry skin who need intense hydration.
products.skip_if: You have oily or acne-prone skin that breaks out with heavy creams.

cons: May be too rich for very oily skin

why: CeraVe Daily Moisturizing Lotion is highlighted as the best overall eczema lotion by NBC News.
It contains ceramides and hyaluronic acid to help restore the skin barrier.
products.desc: A fragrance‑free lotion that includes ceramides and hyaluronic acid to moisturize and support the skin barrier. It does not contain prescription steroids.
products.benefit: Picture a person with eczema who wants a daily moisturizer that won’t irritate their skin. This lotion provides a simple, non‑prescription option that helps keep the skin hydrated and reduces itching. It is the only product in this guide that is specifically labeled as the best overall, making it a solid first choice. The catch: it may not fully stop severe flare‑ups.
products.best_for: people with eczema looking for a daily, non‑prescription moisturizer
products.skip_if: severe, persistent eczema requiring prescription treatment

verdict.pick: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Double Repair Face Moisturizer
